question.text: Consider a system with $\mathbf{2}$ processes that share $\mathbf{5}$ instances of the same resource type. Each process can request a maximum of $\mathbf{k}$ instances. Resources can be requested and released only one at a time. The largest value of $\mathbf{K}$ that will always avoid deadlock is $\_\_\_\_$ .
question.subject: Operating System

question.text: Disk requests come to disk driver for cylinders $\mathbf{15, 80, 5, 25, 60,}$ and $\mathbf{30}$ in that order at a time when the disk drive is reading from cylinder $\mathbf{7 0}$. The seek time is $\mathbf{5 msec}$ per cylinder. Assume the disk has $100$ cylinders ($0$ to $99$), and the head is currently moving towards $99$. Compute the total seek time (in msec) if the disk arm scheduling algorithm is SCAN (ELEVATOR).
question.subject: Operating System

question.text: Consider a system where a single resource type has $\mathbf{5}$ instances. Each process can request a maximum of $\mathbf{4}$ instances. Resources can be requested and released only one at a time. The largest number of processes (N) that the system can support while always avoiding deadlock is $\_\_\_\_$ .
question.subject: Operating System

question.text: Disk requests come to the disk driver for cylinders $\mathbf{8 , 9 0 , 1 5 , 6 5 , 4 0}$, and $\mathbf{7 5}$ in that order at a time when the disk drive is reading from cylinder $\mathbf{5 5}$. The seek time is $\mathbf{7 ~ m s e c}$ per cylinder. Assume the head is currently moving towards $\mathbf{0}$ (INWARD). Compute the total seek time ( in msec) if the disk arm scheduling algorithm is LOOK.
question.subject: Operating System

question.text:
A computer system supports a logical address space of $2^{36}$ bytes. It uses two-level hierarchical paging with a page size of $\mathbf{8 1 9 2}$ bytes. A logical address is divided into a c-bit index to the outer page table, an offset within the page of the inner page table, and an offset within the desired page. Each entry of the inner page table uses four bytes. All the pages in the system have the same size.

The value of $\mathbf{c}$ is $\_\_\_\_$ (Answer in integer).
question.subject: Operating System
